about: S2's boats: the boat kit's coming options (catalogue §4, B1-B11; gen/expand/round2/kit_progress.md) each boat should get when they land, read from the map's `what` and the scan, so the rerun is quick. Until then river.json `boats` uses only the kit's current options (the boats agent, Run 2). After adding them: python3 gen/sections/canal/merge_choices.py, node tools/map_layout.mjs S2, node tools/export_web_scene.mjs canal --boats-only, and the crew check (gen/sections/canal/boats/crew_check.py) again: B1 canopies on posts and B4 open cabins let the crew moved out from under the closed awnings go back to their painted spots (crew_fix.json lists them).
